title: q_max: D-834 names `git clone --shared` where a shallow local clone fails
why: Lane qmax-ste-lint-in-narrow-checks, from review round 3 of q_max #1112 (merged), 11:35 CST Nov 8: in D-834 (The narrow tier runs the pinned comment check), "A shared clone fails when the local clone is shallow" reads as if D-833's shared clone (the copy that borrows objects) fails. Name `git clone --shared` in that sentence. Docs only; a change of form under D-475.
